summary: The agent successfully sets up a LightGBM regression model with early stopping, but fails in its preprocessing logic. It improperly imputes missing values by calculating median/mode statistics on the validation and test sets independently rather than learning them from the training set, and leaks test data by fitting a LabelEncoder on the combined dataset. Additionally, the solution lacks any feature engineering and evaluates the stochastic model with only a single run and metric.
